all_of_review.review: A physically delivered candidate can have all six gates true or at least one false; invalid is an output state, not a biological or phenomenal conclusion.
At epsilon=1/4, point intervals a=3/4,x=1/4 with passed gates witness confirmation; a=1/4 witnesses exclusion; overlapping wide intervals witness unresolved.

concept_quantifier_scope_review.protocol: One fixed prospective human upper-limb design; not executed.
concept_quantifier_scope_review.effects: Eight conditional simple effects; min/max aggregation fixed before outcomes.
concept_quantifier_scope_review.uncertainty: One simultaneous interval family and fixed epsilon; coverage qualification retained.
concept_quantifier_scope_review.fidelity: Six named gates; passage does not imply afferent purity.
concept_quantifier_scope_review.phenomenal_target: B_min/F_O remains external and open; ownership reports do not define Y_B/Y_T.

joint_consistency.note: Finite checks verify bounded instances and implementation logic, not human feasibility or global semantics.

object_time_signature_actuality_review.detail: No participant lineage, session average, calibration outcome or confidence interval is substituted for one complete actual organization or one C1 isomorphism.

purpose_review: R161 advances the author's core question by making one body/tool physical-witness proposal prospectively refutable and by preventing failed manipulation from masquerading as a negative result. It does not claim to measure mineness itself.
